parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is right, I'm completely dry after that roll. The 11 gave Hadar an אבן and an עץ, which brings her even closer to winning since she's already at 4 points. My main priority is ensuring she doesn't get the טיט she needs to build her final settlement. She gets two טיט if a 6 rolls, so the table needs to be ready to block her or use the robber if that happens. I'll acknowledge Shon's comment to keep our 'slippery but useful' alliance against Hadar active.
parsed.note_to_self: Hadar gets 2 טיט on a 6. That is her likely win condition. No one should trade her טיט.
parsed.say_outloud: לגמרי יבש. כל עוד הטיט לא מגיע להדר, אני בסדר עם זה.
